# Field Inventory

Every custom field in source, with its data-sensitivity labels (`securityClassification` / `complianceGroup`).
No PHI or payment-data fields exist by design. Custom Metadata fields have no sensitivity label (config, not data).

## Account

| Field | Label | Type | Sensitivity | Compliance | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Account_Key__c` | Account Key | Text (External ID, Unique) | Internal |  | Data Loader upsert key, e.g. ACC-0001. |
| `Billing_Account_Number__c` | Billing Account Number | Text (External ID, Unique) | Confidential |  | Zuora account number (simulated). Written back by billing sync. Format A########. |
| `ChurnZero_Account_Id__c` | ChurnZero Account Id | Text (External ID) | Internal |  | ChurnZero account ID (simulated mapping key). |
| `ChurnZero_Health_Score__c` | ChurnZero Health Score | Number | Confidential |  | Inbound from ChurnZero only (ADR-004). Read-only on layouts. |
| `Data_Completeness_Band__c` | Data Completeness Band | Text | Internal |  | Grouping for the Data Quality dashboard. |
| `Data_Completeness__c` | Data Completeness | Percent | Internal |  | Share of 5 critical fields filled. |
| `HubSpot_Company_Id__c` | HubSpot Company Id | Text (External ID) | Internal |  | HubSpot company ID (simulated mapping key). |
| `Lifecycle_Stage__c` | Lifecycle Stage | Picklist | Internal |  | Written only by Flow EH_Account_Lifecycle_From_Subscription. Mapped to HubSpot lifecycle (docs/SYNC_RULES.md). |
| `Practice_Type__c` | Practice Type | Picklist | Public |  | Customer segment. Not clinical data. |
